notes: Box-level scores on 200 held-out frames from the official RipVIS val split, never used in training: 150 rip frames spread across 30 rip videos and 50 no-rip frames, sampled with a fixed seed. A predicted box is correct if it overlaps an unmatched ground-truth box (the box around an annotated rip polygon) with IoU >= 0.5, greedy matching. F2 = 5PR/(4P+R) weights recall over precision, because missing a rip is worse than a false alarm. Gemini: gemini-3.5-flash-lite, one fixed zero-shot prompt, unparseable answers count as no detection. RipWatch: confidence >= 0.25, a threshold chosen from the dev-set F1 curve (dev videos are carved out of train), never from test data.
